resources.string: Open PDF songbooks and export your song list
Save or restore playback settings with a file
Privacy, music rights and library notices
Play sound effects and assign your own clips
Microphone, voice effects and song scores
Bring your own library from Android Files. Imported music is stored on this device and played locally.
Choose a karaoke folder above or add individual music files below. Change stage backgrounds in Menu → Stage & Visual.
KANTA checks SoundFont files before you can use them. Large MIDI or KAR files may take longer to import.
The countdown leads into the first line. Use the transport for Play, Pause, Restart, and Next — and tap the Stage for fullscreen lyrics.

In Menu → Voice & Scoring, tap Choose output under Hear My Voice and select your headphones. Allow microphone access when asked. Start quietly. If you hear nothing, check the input meter and both volume controls, or reconnect and select your headphones again. Use wired or USB headphones during songs. Bluetooth headsets may work between songs on Android 12 or later. Speakers cannot play your microphone.

Open Menu → Browser Remote and start hosting. Guests open the HTTPS address from the QR on their phones and pair with the code. The QR only shows the address — it does not pair. Share pairing codes only with people you trust on the same private network, and use music you have permission to use.
